Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYour:
May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System?
You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.
Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNote:
It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES.
Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.
Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system.
Keep reading?

A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize.
The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON.
Keep reading?

When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last.
If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.
In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.
